patient-explanation: Your weekly intake of White Chocolate on April 26 exceeded the recommended limit. For health reasons related to your cardiovascular and diabetes conditions, your daily intake of high-calorie foods like White Chocolate should be limited to 30g per week. On Thursday, you consumed 50g, which is above the recommended amount.
physician-explanation: The monitoring rule Rule-0007 (ID: 0007) for fsfood:FOOD-19014 (White Chocolate), with a specified threshold of 30g and operator 'Less', was violated. The user consumed 50g of White Chocolate in the Dining meal on April 26, 2025 (within the weekly monitoring timeframe). Since the actual value (50g) exceeds the upper threshold (30g), the violation was triggered as this exceeds the recommended limit specified by the rule. This violates the weekly monitoring constraint imposed for patients with cardiovascular disease and diabetes.
